mutants.name: m1-arm-keyed-on-qa_steps-again
mutants.why: Thread 13: the new (e) arm must fire when an executable has zero uppercase headings regardless of qa_steps. Reverting it to key on qa_steps causes an executable with H3 headings and no qa_steps to lint clean (exit 0) when it should FAIL.

mutants.name: m2-is_executable-reads-execution-field
mutants.why: Thread 13: _is_executable must key on the plan KIND (basename / Type: field), not the Execution: field. Diagnostics carry Execution: too; reading that field incorrectly marks them as executable and fires a false (e) FAIL.

mutants.name: m3-lifecycle-prefix-strip-removed
mutants.why: Thread 13: the lifecycle prefix must be stripped before the basename check so that ready-executable-x.md is recognised as an executable. Removing the strip causes ready-executable-x.md to fail the startswith check and exit 0 when it should FAIL.
